title: fix(plugin-form): the print row-cap test loads the line grid's body before its first render (#36640)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PC4syDJ8bPonzN7bL9mdeU)_

Fixes #36640

Also the cause of #36649 (main's 4-hourly full run red at `e9fa6b5d06`); that card closes when the next full run is green.

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lineItemsPrintRowCap-11958.test.tsx` loads the line grid's body at module scope (`await preloadGridField()`), before any test renders. No assertion is changed, removed, relaxed or retried; no timeout is touched; the file is not moved into `heavyDomTests`. Test-only: no product code moves, so no changeset (needs `skip-changeset`).

## Why

Root cause, read from both failure logs and confirmed with a probe:

- Both reds fail at **line 100** (`expected +0 to be 2`), the single row count read right after `waitFor` sees the row-ceiling note: the merge-queue run on PR #36461 (reading 7092248222) and main's 4-hourly run 45135779472, job 137562669352 (`Test UI (3/16)`, `lineItemsPrintRowCap-11958.test.tsx:100:58`). Lines 112 and 118 never failed.
- The note and the rows commit together (`setRowCap` and `setRows` are set in the same load callback in `LineItemsPanel.tsx`), but the grid's body is split out and loads on first use (objectstack#36102, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.ts`). `LineItemsPanel` starts that load at mount with `preloadGridField()` but does not wait for it, so a grid mounted before the load settles draws its loading face (`data-testid="grid-field-loading"`, no table) while the note is already in the DOM.
- Probe at line 100 on unmodified `main` (`3cf6a44b`): `loadingFace=true tbody=false`. The count of 0 is the loading face, not a missing or extra row.

This is the case `ui/AGENTS.md` § 测试纪律 names: an assertion that lands behind a dynamic `import()` loads that module at module scope, where the cost is outside every test window. Three sibling tests in this package already do exactly this (`ModalForm.untypedRepeater.test.tsx`, `masterDetailSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx`, `deriveMasterDetail.declaredSpelling.test.tsx`).

Product side, considered and not changed: in the browser the note can sit under the grid's loading face only until the chunk that `preloadGridField()` already requested arrives, and printing is a user-triggered `window.print()`, so no printed page carries the note without its rows. The row cap and the note are unchanged.

## Verification

All counts on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, the 6-test file run alone with `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lineItemsPrintRowCap-11958.test.tsx` from `ui/`, 20 runs each, under load (one busy loop per core on a 4-core container, so the file runs against 4 CPU stressors):

| Tree | Red runs | Failing test |
|---|---|---|
| before: `main` `3cf6a44b` | **20 / 20** | `draws the cap’s rows…`, line 100, `expected +0 to be 2` |
| after: this branch `0c621d36` | **0 / 20** | none; every run `Tests 6 passed (6)` |

Run cold, as each fresh vitest run is, the load always loses the race; in CI's full run it loses only when the chunk's transform is slow, which is why the queue and the 4-hourly run saw it intermittently.

Also on `0c621d36`: the whole `plugin-form` package under `--maxWorkers=2`, 245 files / 2766 tests passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing); `eslint` on the changed file clean.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the changed file)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (test-only, publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
